about_girl_syrra_90.m: I know. It still follows me. Just not as closely.
r: Fear does not decide where you stand.

about_girl_syrra_90b.m: No. But it remembers. I will too.

elytharan_liberated_ghost_about_girl_10.m: There is another. A girl. She never came back here when the shades fell. Instead, she hides east of here. Probably in a corner somewhere.

elytharan_liberated_ghost_about_girl_10b.m: Fear does not listen to truth. She made something to keep it away.

elytharan_liberated_ghost_about_girl_10c.m: A folded coin. Copper. She believed evil could be trapped if it could not breathe.

elytharan_liberated_ghost_about_girl_10d.m: Lost. Taken. We do not know which. Only that it never came back.

elytharan_liberated_ghost_about_girl_20.m: You have not forgotten her, have you?
r: I am still trying to understand what happened to the talisman.

elytharan_liberated_ghost_about_girl_20b.m: They used to gather our things. Count them. Decide what mattered.

elytharan_liberated_ghost_about_girl_20c.m: Those above us. Those who studied fear instead of ending it.

elytharan_liberated_ghost_about_girl_30.m: If the talisman still exists, it will not be with the dead.

elytharan_liberated_ghost_about_girl_30b.m: With those who believed fear could be shaped. Go to the Masters.
r: Don't worry, I will take care of this for you guys.

elytharan_liberated_ghost_about_girl_40_.m: What are you doing here? Go find that talisman and bring it to her.

elytharan_liberated_ghost_about_girl_90.m: She came back. We did not think she would.
r: I want to speak to her.

elytharan_liberated_ghost_about_girl_90b.m: She is here because she chose to be. Not because fear left her.
r: Then let me hear it from her.

elytharan_liberated_ghost_about_girl_90c.m: Do not mistake silence for weakness.
r: You do not have to hide anymore.

elytharan_liberated_ghost_default.m: It is so wonderful to finally be free of the evil that surrounded those shades...thank you Elythara!
r: What?! It was thanks to me. You guys are hopeless.

elytharan_liberated_ghost_freed_10.m: Yes! Freed from the rule of those Kha'zaan shades.
r: But that was not Elythara. That was me.

elytharan_liberated_ghost_freed_20.m: Listen you, we've been hiding for Elythara knows how long, and the first thing you say to us is a lie?
r: But it was me, I swear to Elythara it was me.

elytharan_liberated_ghost_freed_30.m: If that is true, then maybe you could help us help someone else?

elytharan_liberated_ghost_initial.m: Oh thank you Elythara! We are freed at last.

about_a_girl.10: Two Elytharan slave ghosts spoke quietly of another who has not joined them at the table. They said she still hides east of them, afraid the Shades might return.
about_a_girl.20: The ghosts said the girl believed she could protect herself with a folded copper talisman she made long ago, but she lost it before she could hide it away from the evil of Undertell.
about_a_girl.30: They remembered that such objects were sometimes taken during inspections, gathered with other personal effects and carried upward to the Masters.
about_a_girl.40: I was told that one of the Masters may still possess the folded copper talisman, kept not for protection, but for understanding.
about_a_girl.50: A Master acknowledged the talisman when I asked about it. He spoke of fear made solid, and said such fear was useful to those who taught the Shadow obedience rather than faith. It can be found in the "lower records", whatever that means.
about_a_girl.60: In the Undertell archival room, I found the folded coin talisman.
about_a_girl.70: I found the terrified girl hiding behind a collapsed rock wall. She would not approach me, nor leave her hiding place.
about_a_girl.80: I tossed the folded copper talisman to her. Only then did she step forward, no longer clinging to the corner she had claimed as safety.
about_a_girl.90: The girl rejoined the others at the table. The Elytharan ghosts spoke her name softly, as if afraid to lose her again.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
